whatItIs.statement: A two-state button that can be either on or off.

whenToUse.statement: Use Toggle when a button-like control needs a persistent pressed and unpressed state.

howToUse.statement: Use pressed with onPressedChange for controlled state, or defaultPressed for uncontrolled initial state.
Provide an accessible name such as aria-label when the Toggle contains only an icon.

options.statement: Use variant="outline" for the outline style; default is the standard transparent style.
Toggle size supports sm, default, and lg.
